prompt:
GAME ITEM SPRITE. One single object seen from above at a slight angle, centred, like an item lying on the ground in a top-down strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for a medical chest kept at a remote outpost, so a doctor on the radio can say exactly which item to use. Images 1 and 2 are our approved items from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A sturdy rectangular olive-green steel chest with rounded corners and two folding carry handles, its hinged lid propped open. Inside, a neat grid of small compartments holding white boxes, small brown bottles, rolled bandages and a pair of scissors, each compartment marked only by a small round coloured dot. On the inside of the open lid, a pale paper chart showing the simple outline of a human body divided into a few coloured areas.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted olive, steel and paper colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, crosses, crescents, logos, labels, people, animals or ground. No shadow outside the object.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite for a small portable radio relay mast left standing in the wilderness. Images 1 and 2 are our approved antennas from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Portrait canvas. The mast fills about 80 percent of the canvas height, centred, on a plain pure white background.

A slim galvanised steel lattice mast on a small square steel base plate, held by three thin guy wires pegged into the ground around it. At its top, a short vertical antenna rod with a small ball tip. Halfway up, a small tilted dark blue solar panel on a bracket. At its foot, a rugged weatherproof grey radio box with a short black cable running up the mast.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted galvanised steel and grey with the dark blue panel, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, people, animals, vehicles or ground texture. No shadow outside the object.
